title: Human-approved planning-evidence priority update
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 2 request to implement the five highest-priority OpenFS tasks and create a pull request. Reconcile the HPCI system inventory with official lifecycle and configuration evidence, strengthen public procurement evidence without deriving unsupported component prices, create a measured and testable GENESIS calibration candidate without treating it as an accepted forecast, and publish a qualitative application-demand-to-infrastructure-requirements matrix. Keep every research result provisional and Consensus-incomplete. Validate, push, and create a reviewable pull request. Do not merge the pull request or deploy production GitHub Pages without a separate explicit instruction.
